The same version string is shown inside the app under Settings > About, so
what is installed on a phone can be compared against what is published here
without reinstalling anything.

The download URL never changes, which is what makes two different builds look
like the same one. To check before installing: open this file on the phone
and compare the version against Settings > About. To be certain the download
is not a cached copy — the raw endpoint sends cache-control: max-age=300 —
append anything to the URL as a query string, for example ?v=48b7b43
